scope: All 29 purged fit intervals of the original three folds. Paths start at the first fit decision after a common zero-tilt prefix. Each execution band builds its own reachable inventory.
deduplication: Report exact bond-code and face-value groups, and distinct (faces, lagged cash, lagged NAV, opening net NAV) states within them. Equal weight per distinct state within date, then equal weight per market interval. Validate duplicate-state labels agree.
diagnostics: Net four-action gains versus hold, common-optimal-action intersection, mean and quantiles of ex-post gain from state-specific selection, action cost and trade counts. Ex-post opportunity is a diagnostic, not forecast performance or an expansion gate.
boundary: No validation or test access. Preserve original inventory experiment gate. This stage does not fit a new selector.
